WIN THE GAME: SHOW US TO GET 3 HACK CLUB STICKERS
HOW IT EMBODIES THE “BOUNCE BACK” THEME:
• Trampoline Bounce Slam: Catapult high off bouncy pads and trampolines, then press [SPACE] or Left-Click mid-air to unleash the colossal Bounce Back Ground Slam dealing huge area damage to hordes of villains!
• Enemy Knockback: Every villain fireball and boss stomp bounces you backwards down the stairs to prevent you from winning. Master your footing to bounce back and continue scaling the stairs!
• Resilience: Falling in Sky Dungeons never wipes your items or progress. You bounce right back with your progress saved!
GAMEPLAY OBJECTIVE & 5 SKY DUNGEONS:
1. The 2000 Stairs: Scale 2000 monumental stairs towards the Haven Sanctuary.
2. 5 Sky Dungeons: Step into glowing portals at stairs 200, 500, 900, 1300 & 1700. Defeat both waves to rescue Spider-Man, Thor, Iron Man, Black Panther, and Dumbledore into your team!
3. Final Boss Climax (Step 1900): Face Voldemort & Supreme Dr. Doom before entering Haven!
Controls: [W][A][S][D] Move • [SPACE] Jump / Bounce Slam • [Left-Click] Cast Blue Fireballs • [Right-Click] Knockback • [V] / [F5] Toggle POV (1st Person, 3rd Person Back, 3rd Person Front) • [E] Enter / Exit Dungeons • [B] Magic Shop • [M] Toggle BGM • [H] Heal (+25 HP) • [F] Fullscreen
